summary: Retest of CRITICAL FAB tap-to-open bug (iteration_98) after fix adding .minDistance(1) + moving tap/drag decision from onEnd to onFinalize in IssueReporterButton.tsx. Fix CONFIRMED WORKING. All 6 test scenarios passed: plain click() tap opens sheet, true mouse down/up tap opens sheet, 150-200px drag moves FAB without opening sheet and snaps to edge, position persists correctly across page reload, full end-to-end report submission flow (tap FAB -> open sheet -> pick category -> fill title/description -> submit -> success message) works and was verified server-side via GET /api/issues (admin), and quick regression (FAB hidden on /emergency and /admin-issues) still holds.

critical_code_review_comments: The onFinalize-based tap/drag decision is a correct and robust fix for the web Gesture.Pan() activation-threshold issue — verified empirically with both plain .click() (0px) and literal mouse down/up at identical coordinates.

Good defensive comment block above the Gesture.Pan() definition explaining why onEnd was wrong and why onFinalize + shared-value delta (vs event translationX/Y) is correct — useful for future maintainers.

rca_of_issue: Previous bug: Gesture.Pan() on web only activates (and thus only fires onEnd) once movement exceeds the default ~10px threshold, so a near-zero-movement tap never reached onEnd and openSheet() was never called. Fix: added .minDistance(1) to lower the activation threshold, and moved the tap-vs-drag decision + snap/persist logic into onFinalize, which always fires exactly once regardless of whether the gesture reached ACTIVE state. The delta is now computed from shared values (translateX.value - startX.value) instead of event.translationX/Y, since translation only updates inside onUpdate (so it's reliably 0 for an un-activated tap). Verified fix resolves the issue for both scripted click() and literal mouse down/up at identical coordinates.
